subject: IR plan request + sanitized postmortem exchange for Mediconnect
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@mediconnect.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@mediconnect.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 12:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: IRP and redacted postmortem + SOC 2 mapping

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this — we had a brief authentication anomaly last week that affected a subset of developer API keys tied to our integration with Redwood. The issue was contained quickly and did not surface customer data, but our security/compliance team needs two specific items to close our internal review and map to SOC 2 evidence:

- A copy of Redwood's Incident Response Plan (IRP) or a summary mapped to SOC 2 CC6 and CC7 controls.
- A sanitized (redacted) postmortem for the event with a clear timeline, impact assessment, and mitigations. We need redactions for any Redwood customer identifiers and for PII.

Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? We prefer a secure upload (SFTP or pre-signed link) and a brief statement of what fields/telemetry you will redact so our auditors can sign off.

Lena Ortiz
Head of Security Operations
Mediconnect Health
lena.ortiz@mediconnect.com

--
Attachment: none (please advise on expected filenames and upload method)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@mediconnect.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: IRP and redacted postmortem + SOC 2 mapping

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and for the clear asks. We can provide both items. Quick plan:

1) IRP summary mapped to SOC 2 controls (we'll include the control references and the artifacts you can cite).
2) A redacted postmortem PDF that includes timeline (UTC), impact summary, root cause analysis, and mitigations.
3) A short redaction statement describing what we removed/hashed for auditor review.

Looping in Marissa (security) and Karthik (IR ops) to prepare the artifacts and propose an upload path. Expect an initial delivery within 48 business hours — if you need faster turnaround we'll escalate.

Do you have a maximum redaction tolerance from your auditors (for example, allowed hash-only identifiers vs full suppression)? That will help us size the artifact.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Customer Security Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: IRP and redacted postmortem + SOC 2 mapping

Thanks Rachel — prepping artifacts. Notes and proposed package below (internal):

Package contents (proposed):
- Redwood_IRP_v2.pdf (IRP master copy; redacted/sanitized summary will be generated as IRP_summary_for_mediconnect.pdf)
- postmortem_redacted_mediconnect_20261117.pdf (redacted postmortem draft)
- redaction_guidelines.md (short bullets on what we redact and why)
- telemetry_export_instructions.txt (how we deliver sample logs/excerpts)

Redaction approach (high-level):
- Customer identifiers (Redwood account IDs, internal tenant IDs) -> replaced with stable hashes (SHA256 truncated) so your auditors can reference reproducible IDs without seeing real tokens.
- IP addresses -> first two octets masked (x.x.*.*) for network-level evidence; full redaction available on request.
- Usernames / email addresses -> replaced with role-aliases (eg: developer_1) unless explicit consent is provided.
- Timestamps -> delivered in UTC; we can provide rounded timestamps + offset mapping table if needed.
- Full request/response payloads -> include request path + truncated headers; bodies removed where they contain customer data.

Delivery method: secure SFTP expiring link (we'll create a one-time directory). If Mediconnect requires a separate encrypted archive or direct S3 presigned link, we can do that as well.

ETA: draft redacted postmortem and IRP summary by EOD 2026-11-17 PST. Final upload (with telemetry excerpts) by 2026-11-18 pending your sign-off on the redaction approach.

I'll attach the IRP master for internal reference to the outgoing package. Ben, can you confirm we have the telemetry sample slices prepared?

Marissa Cole
Head of Security
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: Redwood_IRP_v2.pdf (master, internal)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: IRP and redacted postmortem + SOC 2 mapping

Quick clarifying points for the postmortem content (for Mediconnect auditor expectations):

- Our sanitized postmortem standard includes:
  * Executive summary (one paragraph)
  * Chronological timeline with redacted IDs
  * Impact and scope (what customers, if any, were impacted)
  * Root cause analysis (technical summary)
  * Mitigations and long-term fixes, with owners and ETA
  * Artifacts list (logs, telemetry slices, S3 paths) — we provide excerpts only.

- We will not include full log archives in the PDF; instead we provide verified excerpts and a separate zipped evidence bundle on SFTP. Excerpts will have the same redaction rules Marissa outlined.
- If Mediconnect's auditors require CAIQ mapping in addition to SOC2, confirm and we'll include a short CAIQ crosswalk doc.

I will prepare the redaction script note so the hashes can be reproduced by an auditor if required (we store salts per customer).

Karthik
Incident Response Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redaction_guidelines.md

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@mediconnect.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Delivery: Redacted postmortem and IRP summary for Mediconnect (SFTP upload)

Hi Lena — following up with the package we discussed. Delivery summary:

Files uploaded to your one-time SFTP directory (link expires 2026-11-25): sftp://sftp.redwood-inference.com/mediconnect_uploads
- IRP_summary_for_mediconnect.pdf (2 pages) — high-level IRP mapped to SOC 2 CC6/CC7 and notes on evidence locations
- postmortem_redacted_mediconnect_20261117.pdf (redacted postmortem; includes timeline, impact, RCA, mitigations)
- redaction_guidelines.md (short explanation of redaction rules used)

Short notes:
- We replaced tenant/account IDs with stable truncated SHA256 hashes; IPs were masked to preserve network context while removing exact addresses.
- No customer data was present in our redacted PDF; telemetry excerpts were truncated per your request.
- If your auditors require the CAIQ crosswalk, let us know and we'll attach a CAIQ mapping doc (we can add it to the same SFTP dir).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm receipt and whether the redaction level is acceptable to your auditors.
2) If you need additional artifacts (more granular log excerpts or signed attestations), we can prepare a formal evidence bundle under NDA/portal access.

Thanks — and apologies again for the disruption. We're happy to hop on a short call with your security team to walk through the artifacts.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Customer Security Manager
Redwood Inference
